tsType.name: signature

properties.description: The name of the step, always visible.
Where the step is in the flow; at most one step can be `current`.
Supporting detail under the title; on an error step it is the error text.

orientation.description: Whether the steps are laid out in a row or a column.

prefix.description: The visually hidden text read before the step, chosen by its state.

countLabel.description: The position text of the step, for example `Step 2 of 7`.

showStepCount.description: Whether the position text is visible.

showDetails.description: Whether the description is visible on steps that aren't in error.
